page.overview:
What is Jharth?

Jharth is a small island that is part of the present day Terisian Isles of Dominaria. It lies in the Sea of Laments, midway between Gulmany and New Argive.

Jharth is popularly believed to be located in the region of the former Ronom Lake of old Terisiare.
